The '''Alliance for the Creation of Habitable Environments''' was a scientific organization that existed during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They produced the documentary, ''[[A Galaxy Befuddled]]'', which was hosted by [[A. Rahring]].
